authority: D1 (Ahmed decision block) + D2 (margin inherited from docs/EXPERIMENTAL_DESIGN_V2.md H1; recall-superiority half NOT inherited)
statistic: D = F1_pooled(RM-CSS) - F1_pooled(Agent) over the same N task IDs, where F1_pooled = 2*sum(TP) / (sum(|pred|) + sum(|gold|)). This is the aggregation that reproduces the frozen RESERVE-300 values 0.26474622770919065 (SIP) / 0.35687263556116017 (RM-CSS).

ci_method.unit: task (resample task IDs with replacement and recompute both pooled F1 values each draw)

ni_decision.rule: the 5th percentile (Q5) of the bootstrap D distribution (one-sided 95% lower bound, per docs/STATISTICAL_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md section 3) > -0.05
ni_decision.note: The NI decision uses Q5, while the reporting CI in wp1a_shared_scorer_schema.json is [Q2.5, Q97.5]. They are different quantities, not a conflict.

coherence_anchor.note: Delta=0.05 is below the lower bound 0.0691, so an NI verdict cannot hide an F1 loss as large as the method gain the thesis itself claims. Delta=0.03 is about 50% of that lower bound (the stricter sensitivity).

relative_size.note: Delta=0.05 is about 14.0% of RM-CSS F1 on RESERVE-300 (0.3569) and about 12.7% on MAIN_50 (0.3923).

inheritance_quote: H1: Impact accuracy | A | hybrid_selective vs repository_agent / single_shot_llm_scope | F1 non-inferiority (Delta=0.05) + recall superiority
inheritance_record: Only the margin is inherited (D2). The recall-superiority half of H1 is NOT inherited; recall is reported as a secondary descriptive metric with CI.
recall_secondary: recall reported as a secondary descriptive metric with CI, never as a primary claim
falsifiers: This freeze is wrong if an authoritative frozen artifact defines a different F1 NI margin for the selection-only comparison (none found; see WP1B_NI_MARGIN_DECISION_REQUIRED_2026-09-21.md).
It is wrong if the margin is interpreted as the [Q2.5,Q97.5] reporting CI rather than the Q5 one-sided rule.
